description: Lists review comments people left on the site in Xodia, newest change first, as text: each thread's id, page, screen size (with the canvas width and which take_screenshot viewport to check it at), the element it is on (source, tag and text) or empty space, and every comment with its author. Open threads by default; status "archived" lists resolved ones. Narrow with route and breakpoint. Use it before and after work on a page, and check each comment at its own screen size. Each thread's link is for the user to open in Xodia. Answer with reply_to_comment; only a person resolves a thread.

branch.description: Default: the branch the workspace has open, else the site's default branch

breakpoint.description: Only threads made at this screen size: "base" (Phone), "sm" (Large phone), "md" (Tablet), "lg" (Desktop), "xl" (Large desktop), "2xl" (Wide desktop)

cursor.description: From the previous answer, for older threads

route.description: Only threads on this page path, like /about

name: list_comments
title: List comments
